headline: Tesla's long-delayed Roadster finally nears its production debut
summary: Nearly a decade after Elon Musk's surprise announcement, the Tesla Roadster is finally making its production-ready debut, billed as one of the fastest cars ever made. The overdue hypercar arrives into an EV market that has grown skeptical of electric hypercars.
